senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. foreg.), pl. constr. אַחֲרֵי after, behind.
units: Gen. R. s. 44 wherever the Bible uses the preposition aḥaré סמוך, it means in connection with, אחר מופלג while aḥar means without connection (later on).

<cite ref="Yoma 6a:8">Yoma 6ᵃ</cite> <he>אחר א׳</he> after ‘after’, i.e. some time after the act, opp. <he>חד אחר</he> one ‘after’, immediately, v. <cite ref="A00593"><he>אֶוְתִּיוֹס</he></cite>.—<he>לְאַחֲרָיו</he>, <he>לְאַחֲרֶיהָ</he>, <he>מֵאַחֲרָיו</he>, <he>מֵאַחֲרֶיהָ</he> after it, as concluding, opp. <he>לפניה</he>, <he>לפניו</he> introductory (prayer).—
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:4">Ber. I, 4</cite> <he>אחת לא׳</he> one benediction after the Sh’ma.

<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 3:4">Ib. III, 4</cite> <he>לאחריו</he> (prayer) after meal; a. fr.—<he>כִּלְאַחַר יד</he> as if doing a thing with the back of the hand, i.e. in a manner different from the usual way of doing it.

senses.gloss: (conj. followed by ש־ or ד־) after, since, whereas, because.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 29a:22">Ḥull. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>מא׳ ששנינו</he> after it has once been stated in the Mishnah … why was it necessary (?) &c.
<cite ref="Chullin 29b:2">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>ומאחר דאפי׳ וכ׳</he> and since it is not even rabbinically unfit, why &c.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: a legal term, meaḥar, the presumption of the truth of one’s statement, because he might have pleaded more profitably, if he had been inclined to lie.
units: Y. Shebu. VI, 36ᵈ bot. אין אומרים בממון מא׳ מאחר וכ׳ in money matters we do not apply the principle of meaḥer, so as to say that because he might have said ‘thou hast not lent me anything’, he may say, ‘thou didst lend me, but I paid half of it’ (and his plea must be accepted without an oath); v. מִיגּוֹ s. v. גּוֹ.—אַחֲרֶיךָ thy successor.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:10">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᶜ</cite> top <he>יהודה בני א׳ וכ׳</he> my son Judah shall succeed thee, none else (is worthy).
Keth. 95ᵇ my property I bequeath to thee ואַחֲרַיִיךְ לפ׳ and after thee it shall go over to …—אַחַר כָּךְ (abbrev. אח״כ) afterwards, subsequently.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 10:2">Pes. X, 2</cite>; a. v. fr.
